transit_card.trigger.mercury: A rush of thoughts and messages
transit_card.trigger.venus: The wish for closeness and pleasure
transit_card.trigger.jupiter: A wave of growth and opportunity
transit_card.trigger.saturn: A test of patience and effort
transit_card.trigger.neptune: A fog of dreams and doubts
transit_card.acts.sun: The Sun puts attention on this part of you for a few days.
transit_card.acts.moon: The Moon colours your mood for a day or so.
transit_card.acts.mercury: Mercury brings talk, news and decisions, for a few days to a few weeks.
transit_card.acts.venus: Venus brings warmth, pleasure and attention to what you value, for a few days.
transit_card.acts.mars: Mars brings energy, heat and the urge to act, for a few days to a few weeks.
transit_card.acts.jupiter: Jupiter widens things and brings chances, over weeks to months.
transit_card.acts.saturn: Saturn slows things down and asks for steady work. It stays for a long while, often about a year.
transit_card.acts.uranus: Uranus brings surprises and the need for more freedom. It comes and goes over a year or more.
transit_card.acts.neptune: Neptune softens and blurs things. It brings ideals, and also confusion, slowly, over a few years.
transit_card.acts.pluto: Pluto brings slow, deep pressure to change something for good, over a year or more.
transit_card.acts.chiron: Chiron brings an old hurt to the surface so that it can heal. It can stay from a few months to a year or two.
transit_card.feel.conjunction: The two run together as one, so the effect is strong and direct.
transit_card.feel.sextile: It is a chance, and it works if you act on it.
transit_card.feel.square: It feels like friction. The stress pushes you to change how you act.
transit_card.feel.trine: It feels easy and natural. Use it, because easy chances are easy to miss.
transit_card.feel.opposition: It feels like a tug-of-war. You may see it first in other people.
transit_card.need.sun: your sense of who you are
transit_card.need.mars: how you stand up for yourself
transit_card.need.jupiter: how you grow and what you believe in
transit_card.need.saturn: how you set limits and carry responsibility
transit_card.need.north_node: the direction you are growing in
transit_card.need.south_node: your old habits and comfort zone
transit_card.todo.sun.conjunction: Put yourself forward in this part of life. People notice you now, so show what you want.
transit_card.todo.sun.sextile: Take one small step that shows who you are. A quiet effort gets noticed.
transit_card.todo.sun.square: Do not force it to prove a point. Ask what you really want here, then act calmly.
transit_card.todo.sun.trine: Be yourself, openly. Things go your way when you do not hold back.
transit_card.todo.sun.opposition: Listen to the people who push back. Find a middle way between you and them.
transit_card.todo.moon.conjunction: Notice how you feel, and give yourself what you need. Rest if you are tired.
transit_card.todo.moon.sextile: Do one small thing that makes you feel at home.
transit_card.todo.moon.square: Your mood may run high. Wait a few hours before a big reply.
transit_card.todo.moon.trine: Trust your gut. Spend time with people who make you feel safe.
transit_card.todo.moon.opposition: Other people's moods may pull at you. Notice which feelings are yours.
transit_card.todo.mercury.conjunction: Write things down and say what you mean. It is a good time for plans, calls and decisions.
transit_card.todo.mercury.sextile: Send the message or make the call you have been putting off.
transit_card.todo.mercury.square: Read things twice before you send them. Expect mix-ups, and stay patient.
transit_card.todo.mercury.trine: Talk it through, learn something new, or sort out paperwork. Words come easily.
transit_card.todo.mercury.opposition: Listen to the other side before you argue. A talk can settle a difference.
transit_card.todo.venus.conjunction: Enjoy something beautiful, or spend time with someone you like. Say yes to warmth.
transit_card.todo.venus.sextile: Make a friendly move: an invitation, a kind word, or a small gift.
transit_card.todo.venus.square: Do not spend or promise too much to feel loved. Ask for what you want.
transit_card.todo.venus.trine: Relax and enjoy. It is a good time for love, art and making peace.
transit_card.todo.venus.opposition: Meet the other person halfway. Be generous, but keep your own wishes in view.
transit_card.todo.mars.conjunction: Start something and put your energy into it. Exercise helps you use the heat.
transit_card.todo.mars.sextile: Act on the plan you have. A little effort goes a long way.
transit_card.todo.mars.square: Expect irritation. Move your body, and do not pick fights you do not need.
transit_card.todo.mars.trine: Push ahead. Hard work and sport go well, and courage pays off.
transit_card.todo.mars.opposition: If someone pushes you, stay calm and firm. Do not let anger make the choice.
transit_card.todo.jupiter.conjunction: Say yes to a good chance here. Aim higher than usual, but keep a budget.
transit_card.todo.jupiter.sextile: Look for an opening and take it. Ask for help; people are willing.
transit_card.todo.jupiter.square: Do not take on too much at once. Check the cost before you say yes.
transit_card.todo.jupiter.trine: Grow what already works. Learn, travel, or share your luck.
transit_card.todo.jupiter.opposition: Weigh big promises from other people. Choose the one that fits your real life.
transit_card.todo.saturn.conjunction: Take this part of life seriously. Make a plan and do the slow work; it lasts.
transit_card.todo.saturn.sextile: Build one steady habit now. Small, regular effort pays later.
transit_card.todo.saturn.square: Expect delays, and do not give up. Cut what does not work, and fix what matters.
transit_card.todo.saturn.trine: Commit for the long term. Work you start now holds up.
transit_card.todo.saturn.opposition: Other people or rules may limit you. Keep your promises, and set fair limits.
transit_card.todo.uranus.conjunction: Let something new in. Change one habit before change is forced on you.
transit_card.todo.uranus.sextile: Try a new way of doing things. A small experiment can open a door.
transit_card.todo.uranus.square: Expect surprises. Stay flexible, and do not quit everything in one go.
transit_card.todo.uranus.trine: Follow the new idea. It is a good time for a fresh start that suits you.
transit_card.todo.uranus.opposition: Other people may shake things up. Ask which part of the change you need too.
transit_card.todo.neptune.conjunction: Dream, create and rest, but check the facts before big decisions.
transit_card.todo.neptune.sextile: Make time for art, music or quiet. Your intuition is a useful guide now.
transit_card.todo.neptune.square: Things may be unclear. Do not sign or decide while you feel confused.
transit_card.todo.neptune.trine: Use your imagination. Kindness and creative work flow well.
transit_card.todo.neptune.opposition: See people as they are, not as you hope. Keep clear limits.
transit_card.todo.pluto.conjunction: Let something end so that something stronger can grow. Do not hold on from fear.
transit_card.todo.pluto.sextile: Make one deep change you have wanted for a while. You have the strength now.
transit_card.todo.pluto.square: Pick your battles. Use the pressure to change one thing for good.
transit_card.todo.pluto.trine: Go deep. Real, lasting change is within reach, and it comes easily.
transit_card.todo.pluto.opposition: Watch for power games with others. Stand your ground without trying to control.
transit_card.todo.chiron.conjunction: Notice what hurts, and ask where you felt it first. Let a safe person help.
transit_card.todo.chiron.sextile: Help someone with what you have learned the hard way. It helps you too.
transit_card.todo.chiron.square: Old pain may flare. Be gentle with yourself, and do not hide from it.
transit_card.todo.chiron.trine: Healing comes easily now. Talk about the old hurt, or ask for support.
transit_card.todo.chiron.opposition: Other people may touch an old wound. Use it to learn what you need.
